scope: Review priorities, not validated family signatures. All supplied ELM classes are scanned in all families. Empty focus lists do not disable scanning. Partner-binding motifs belong to the ligand, not automatically to the named binder.

alpha_actinin.note: Candidate vinculin-binding helix; domain architecture, helix conformation and accessibility require review.

collagen_like.note: Encoded precursor pattern; hydroxylation, triple helix and integrin subtype specificity are not established.

FAK.note: Generic SH3 ligand candidate; not FAK identity or binding evidence.
Generic SH3 ligand candidate; review position and accessibility.
Phosphotyrosine-dependent ligand candidate; phosphorylation and Y397 correspondence cannot be inferred.

fibronectin_like_candidate.note: FNIII-context candidate; neither fibronectin identity nor binding is established.
RGD subtype sequence only; no receptor subtype assignment.
NGR precursor only; deamidation to isoDGR is unverified.

integrin_beta.note: Generic phosphorylation-independent PTB-ligand class; compatible sequence is not specific talin/kindlin binding proof.
Phosphorylation-dependent PTB-ligand candidate; phosphorylation is not assessed.

paxillin_like.note: ELM LD-helix candidate; inspect relationship to C-terminal LIM domains, helix conformation and binding partner.

PTP_PEST.note: Generic SH3 ligand; does not distinguish PTP-PEST from other phosphatases.
Generic SH3 ligand; noncatalytic homology still required.

Src.note: SFK regulatory-tail candidate; no phosphorylation or inhibitory activity claim.
Candidate Csk target pattern; no transfer of human Y530 numbering.
N-terminal myristoylation-compatible sequence only; modification is unverified and not universal to all SFKs.
Reference SRC linker-class screen; positions are not transferred from human SRC.

talin.note: Candidate vinculin-binding helix; force-dependent exposure and binding require structural/experimental evidence.

vinculin.note: Candidate EVH1 ligand; proline-rich context/accessibility required, not vinculin identity.

zyxin_like.note: Candidate Ena/VASP EVH1 ligand; LIM architecture and homologous context remain necessary.
Exploratory polyproline ligand screen; generic interaction potential, not a zyxin signature.
